service.description: The caller's People scope: capabilities from the People and payroll permissions (an edit permission alone reads nothing), the employers a staff reader sees (their own internal organizations, only the active one when it is theirs; every one, or the active one, for a holder of PEOPLE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS, which reads nothing by itself) and the units under them, their own party and current employments, and a manager's live reports. With organizationPartyId, narrows the employers, the units and a staff admission to it and refuses one outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED). With partyId, says how the scope admits that person (self, team or staff) and which of their employments it shows (staff: an employment by an employer in scope, in effect on asOfDate for a directory reader, any for an HR reader), and refuses a person it does not admit as it refuses a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); a supplied party never widens self scope.

parameter.name: asOfDate
parameter.description: The date a directory reader's employments are in effect on; now when empty

parameter.name: checkOnly
parameter.description: For a caller asking whether the person is admitted (a link shown only then): a person missing or outside the scope answers partyAccess empty instead of RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, alike either way

parameter.name: employments
parameter.description: The caller's own current employments: partyRelationshipId, partyId, organizationPartyId, fromDate, thruDate

parameter.name: partyAccess
parameter.description: self, team and staff, as each admits the party asked for

service.description: People Home's summary for a staff reader, over the employers in scope or the one asked for (refused outside the scope, ORGANIZATION_DENIED), as of asOfDate (now when empty): headcount (distinct people) and employments for a staff reader, the joins and exits of the last 30 days for an HR reader, the vacant seats in effect for a position reader (HR, recruiting, payroll, the administrator; P8) and the People decisions waiting on the caller (PEOPLE_REQUEST_APPROVE; P8), each count of a later phase absent (one that cannot be counted is logged and left out); and the due work an HR reader clears (employees with no manager, by name, the first 20 of dueWorkCount). Pay is never counted. Refuses a caller who reads no employer (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: counts
parameter.description: headcount, employments, joins, exits, vacancies and decisions, each present only for a caller who may read it

parameter.name: dueWork
parameter.description: dueKind, dueText, partyId, personName, organizationPartyId, organizationName

service.description: People's setup readiness, answering the framework's readiness contract (moqui.server.ReadinessProvider) with no adapter: called with providerKey and an organizationPartyId (or none, for every employer in the caller's scope), returns checks of checkKey, title, state (ready, warning, failed or unavailable), reasonCode, message, the employer as subject and scope, and fixRoute (the key of People's settings), with the organization's id and name. The checks of what is built, for an organization with current employees (one with none answers no check): a department set up, every employee with a manager, payroll set up (a pay group, every employee on a pay assignment), and (P29) a position, an HR fallback among the approval rules, an onboarding checklist, a working schedule, a leave policy and someone to take confidential cases, each with the key of the place that sets it up. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

The employee directory (design §4 Employees, §15): one row per employment the caller's scope reaches as of asOfDate (now when empty; a date alone is the end of that day): an employment by an employer a staff reader sees, a live report's and, with PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE, the caller's own. Each row is the public work identity (name, preferred name, employer, job title, manager employed by that employer, work email (EmailWork, never EmailPrimary), phone and location, the state); an HR reader (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW) gets the id and dates of an employment by an employer in their scope too, and with includeEnded the ended employments. Never a private contact, identification or pay. Searched by term (name, preferred name or id) in the query ignoring case; filtered by employer (refused outside the scope, ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and manager; paged, or with pageNoLimit (an export) every row up to 2000. Refuses a caller the scope reaches no one for (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: employees

service.description: A person's record as the caller may read it (design §4 Employee360): the regions their access admits, each one they may not read absent from the answer. Overview (any reader the scope admits): the public work identity and the employments the scope shows of the person (an HR reader's with their dates). EmploymentHistory and PersonalInfo (the person, and an HR reader of an employer of theirs): personalInfo holds the private contacts, birth date, gender and the revision store#PersonalInfo checks, the emergency contacts (P8, each with its own revision), and for HR the identifications other than tax ones, values masked. FilesAndActivity (an HR reader of the employer of the employment opened): hostEmploymentId, the employment content host. Compensation (P23; a payroll reader, PAYROLL_VIEW, of the opened employment's employer): the region alone, its content read through PayrollSetupServices.get#Compensation; absent for anyone else, HR included. partyRelationshipId opens an employment the scope shows (else RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); without it, the current one, then the newest. A person outside the scope is refused as a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Never pay, review, case or leave data. A manager shown is one of a shown employment's employer (or employed by none); HR's dates and employment ids are of the employments by an employer in their scope (and a payroll reader's ids, P23).

parameter.name: checkOnly
parameter.description: For a caller that shows the record only when it is readable (a card, a link): a person or employment missing or outside the scope answers access and regions empty instead of RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, alike either way

parameter.name: access
parameter.description: self, team and staff, as get#Scope admits the person

parameter.name: regions
parameter.description: overview, and employmentHistory, personalInfo, filesAndActivity and compensation (P23) as admitted

parameter.name: partyRelationshipId
parameter.description: The employment opened, for the person and HR; null for a directory or team reader

parameter.name: capabilities
parameter.description: editPersonal, editHr, selfFields (the fields the caller may change), files, changeEmployment (an HR editor of the opened employment's employer, P6), changePay (a payroll editor of it, P23)

service.description: A person's employments, newest first, with employer, job title, dates, state and termination reason (design §4 EmploymentHistory), and their dated assignments (P6: dates, state, department, position, manager, work location and the change that started each): an HR reader's of the employers in their scope, any dates; the person's own, all of them. Refuses anyone else (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a person outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: assignments
parameter.description: employmentAssignmentId, partyRelationshipId, organizationName, fromDateText, thruDateText, stateText, departmentName, positionName, managerName, facilityName, changeText, reason

service.description: Correct a person's private data (design §4 PersonalInfo). The person themselves (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE) may change their preferred name and home and mobile phones; an HR editor (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT) of an employer of theirs these and the legal names, birth date, gender and home address. A field left out is unchanged, an empty one is cleared (a legal name cannot be, NAME_REQUIRED). Tax and bank fields are not taken here: they are reviewed payroll setup. Refuses a person outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a caller who may change nothing of the person (PERMISSION_DENIED), a field the caller may not change (FIELD_NOT_PERMITTED) and an expectedRevision other than the current one (REVISION_CHANGED, naming it). Contacts change by date: the one in effect ends and a new one starts.

parameter.name: expectedRevision
parameter.description: personalInfo.revision of get#Employee360

service.description: Whether the caller reads an employment's files and activity, the employment content host (PE-01): an HR reader (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW) of its employer in their scope; canEdit with PEOPLE_HR_EDIT. Never refuses: a relationship that is not an employment, or not the caller's to read, answers recordVisible false, and so does a call with no user. get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles read it.

A file of an employment (EmploymentContent, the record files of get#RecordLinkInfo): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#EmploymentContentFile. Needs an HR editor of the employer (check#EmploymentAccess: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope, PERMISSION_DENIED without PEOPLE_HR_EDIT).
Internal to create#EmploymentContent, which checks the caller: the file of an EmploymentContent row of that employment.

return.message: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: File ${employmentContentId} is not of employment ${partyRelationshipId}

actions.script: const fileStream = contentFile.getInputStream() try { docRr.putStream(fileStream) } finally { fileStream.close() }

service.description: People's HR vocabularies, a whitelist of Enumeration families (termination reasons and types, skill types and levels, leave types, P18's qualification types; later phases add theirs), each with its value count; with enumTypeId, its values in order, current unless includeEnded, each with how many records hold it (useCount), whether it has ended and whether the caller may change it. Read by the People administrator and an HR reader (PEOPLE_CONFIGURE or PEOPLE_HR_VIEW; PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise); refuses another family (FAMILY_INVALID).

parameter.name: families
parameter.description: enumTypeId, title, valueCount

parameter.name: values
parameter.description: enumId, enumTypeId, description, enumCode, sequenceNum, useCount, ended, stateText, canEdit, revision

service.description: A new value of one of People's HR vocabularies (its name, code and order), a value's new name, code or order, or its end (end true, from now): an ended value stays for the records that hold it and is offered for no new one; nothing is deleted. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), a family not People's (FAMILY_INVALID), a value of another family (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no name (DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED), a name a current value of the family has (DUPLICATE_VALUE), an order that is not a whole number from 0 to 9999 (SEQUENCE_INVALID), an ended value (VALUE_ENDED) and a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED).

The terms of a hire: the person (an existing one by partyId, else a new one's names, with term searching for who may be them), the employer and dates, the first assignment's department, position, manager and work location, and the new person's work contacts.

parameter.name: term
parameter.description: A name searched for the person (two characters at least)

parameter.name: confirmNewPerson
parameter.description: A new person although someone matches

parameter.name: employmentOfferId
parameter.description: P17: the accepted offer the hire is made from: its employer and applicant (the person by the offer, whoever else People knows), consumed once by the hire

service.description: A hire checked before it is made (design §4 HireEmployee's Identity and EmploymentTerms): the people who may be the person (People's own search with the entity filters off and public identity only, by the name searched, the names given or the work email, each with their relationships with the employer and none with another employer: a person employed by a second employer is found, not made again, F59), the chosen person's relationships of any type with the employer (an employment, an orphan PrtEmployee relationship, a contractor's, a contact's), the plan (new, an orphan completed, or a rehire beside the ended employment), the terms with their names and the findings: errors that refuse the hire (as hire#Employee does) and warnings and notes. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), no employer (ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED), one outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and a person not found (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: person
parameter.description: partyId (none for a new one), personName, preferredName, isNew

parameter.name: matches
parameter.description: partyId, personName, preferredName, matchedBy, employedNow, relationshipText

parameter.name: plan
parameter.description: new, complete or rehire

parameter.name: terms
parameter.description: departmentPartyId, emplPositionId, managerPartyId, facilityId and their names, fromDateText, thruDateText

parameter.name: findings
parameter.description: code, severity (error, warning, info), message

service.description: A hire in one transaction (design §4, PE-02): the person (chosen, or a new Person whose Party owner is left as it is), the Employee role, exactly one employment (a new one through EmploymentServices.create#Employment, or an orphan PrtEmployee relationship of the employer completed with its Employment row, never a second relationship; a rehire beside the ended one), the first assignment from the start (department, position, manager, work location) with its department membership, position occupancy and reporting line, and the hire's change row. A retry with the same operationKey answers the first hire. Never calls create#PersonEmployee (F5). Refuses as preview#Hire's errors say: no person (PERSON_REQUIRED), a new person someone already matches unless confirmNewPerson (PERSON_MATCHES), an employment of the employer overlapping (EMPLOYMENT_OVERLAP), dates out of order (DATES_INVALID), a department not of the employer (NOT_A_DEPARTMENT, DEPARTMENT_OUTSIDE), a position not of the employer (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), not in effect (POSITION_NOT_IN_EFFECT), inactive (POSITION_INACTIVE), of another department (POSITION_DEPARTMENT) or held then (POSITION_OCCUPIED), a manager not employed by the employer (MANAGER_NOT_EMPLOYED), a work location not the employer's (FACILITY_OUTSIDE). P17: a hire from an accepted offer (employmentOfferId; the offer locked) is of its employer and applicant, takes its working schedule from the first day and consumes it, exactly once: the offer is Hired and its application Hired; refused: an offer hired from already (OFFER_USED: a second hire from it), not accepted (OFFER_NOT_ACCEPTED), of another person or employer (OFFER_PERSON, OFFER_EMPLOYER), of an application refused or withdrawn since (OFFER_APPLICATION_CLOSED), not of the editor's employers (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). The offer's pay, approved with it, is recorded as the employment's first salary from its first day (P23 review, the user's call of Nov 12, 2026; the answer names no amount); no account is asked but by requestAccount.

parameter.name: requestAccount
parameter.description: HR asks for the person's account (P7): recorded on the hire's change, the provisioning an app requests after commit (IronStone: the mr-boss tx-commit rule, ironstone.admin.LifecycleServices.request#Provisioning); nobody gets a login merely to be paid

service.description: An employment change: the employment, what changes (changeKind: transfer, manager, leave, return, separation, or pay, P23), from when, the new terms (a term not passed is kept, an empty one cleared), a leave's return date, a separation's termination reason and type (People's lookups), a pay change's salary (amount, currency, pay frequency and an optional pay grade), and why.

An employment change checked before it is asked for (design §4 EmploymentChange's Change and ImpactAndConfirm): the employment's terms now (department, position, manager, work location, state) and its revision, the new terms with their names, the impact (the seat vacated and the seat taken, the department and reporting line moved; for a separation the employment's end, the reports left with no manager, the units left with no lead, another employer's employment continuing and the approvals routed again), whether it waits for approval (a transfer and a separation) and who would decide it, and the findings: errors that refuse it (as apply#EmploymentChange does) and notes. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an employment outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: impact
parameter.description: kind, impactText

parameter.name: route
parameter.description: stepText, explanation, unresolved

service.description: An employment change from its effective date (design §4 EmploymentChange), at the employment's revision read (expectedRevision): a manager change, a leave of absence (to an optional return date) and a return are applied now; a transfer and a separation wait for approval (a PeopleApproval of kind PakEmploymentChange, routed by the employer's rules, the person's manager by default, never the requester or the person; sent on the PeopleEmploymentChangeApproval topic; with no one who may decide it waits) and are applied by the last approval (decide#EmploymentChange). Applied: the assignment in effect ends on the date and the next starts, the department membership, position occupancy and reporting line follow; a separation ends the employment (thruDate audited with the reason, the termination reason and type), its assignment and projections, the person's lead and team memberships at the employer and the lines they manage there (each report's assignment continues with no manager), leaves another employer's employment alone and routes the employer's waiting People decisions again (a leaver decides nothing). A new change supersedes one of the employment still waiting. A retry with the same operationKey answers the first. P23: a pay change (changeKind pay) is a payroll editor's (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT, not HR's) at the salary revision get#Compensation answers (payRevision): a new salary from the date (salaryAmount, salaryCurrencyUomId, salaryPeriodTypeId, an optional payGradeId; CURRENCY_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_INVALID, AMOUNT_INVALID, CURRENCY_PRECISION, FREQUENCY_REQUIRED, FREQUENCY_INVALID, GRADE_INVALID, SALARY_EXISTS, SALARY_SCHEDULED, a note outside the grade's band) that waits for approval, the first salary too (P23 review, the user's calls of Nov 12, 2026): a request of its own kind, PakPayChange, decided by the employer's payroll approvers (PAYROLL_APPROVE with PAYROLL_VIEW) unless a rule of the kind routes it, never by who asked; applied, the salary in effect ends on the date and the new one starts. It supersedes only a pay change waiting, and only a separation supersedes it. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED; for a pay change, PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT), an employment outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED), no kind (KIND_INVALID), a date outside the employment (DATE_OUTSIDE) or before a change set for it or later (ASSIGNMENT_SCHEDULED), terms that change nothing (NOTHING_CHANGES), no reason for one that waits for approval (REASON_REQUIRED), a leave while on leave (ALREADY_ON_LEAVE), a return while working (NOT_ON_LEAVE), a termination reason or type not of the list or ended (VALUE_INVALID, VALUE_ENDED) and the terms' refusals of hire#Employee (SELF_REPORTING and REPORTING_CYCLE too).

The decision service of an employment change (design §12's PeopleEmploymentChangeApproval): the step waiting of the change's request (peopleApprovalId, else the change's latest) approved, or refused with a reason, through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision, which rechecks that the caller is an approver of that step (never the requester or the person) and that neither the change nor the employment has changed since the request (SOURCE_CHANGED; sourceRevision, the notice's, when given). The last step's approval applies the change, checked again as apply#EmploymentChange checks it; a refusal refuses it. A decision the caller already made answers the first (repeated) and applies nothing again. Refuses as record#Decision does, and as apply#EmploymentChange's checks do when the change no longer fits the employment.

parameter.name: decision
parameter.description: approve or refuse

service.description: The PeopleEmploymentChangeApproval topic's approve service, which the framework's approve#NotificationMessage calls as the user deciding the notice: decide#EmploymentChange at the request and revision in the message (a notice of an earlier revision is refused, REVISION_CHANGED or SOURCE_CHANGED); refuses a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID).
The PeopleEmploymentChangeApproval topic's refuse service, with the reason (the topic requires one): as approve#EmploymentChange, the request and the change refused and the employment left as it is.

A person's employment changes the caller may see (Employee360's changes waiting): an HR reader's of the employers in their scope (those waiting, and with includeDone those applied, refused or superseded), and a waiting one whose step waiting the caller decides (a manager sees their report's transfer to approve it); each with its kind, dates, new terms as names, reason and, while it waits or once refused, its approval (state, who asked, the steps, the decisions, canDecide). Never pay. Others get none.

The caller's own unfinished hire or change (EmploymentDraft; the wizards' draft record, style-guide §3.10): by employmentDraftId, else their newest of the kind (draftKind hire, or change of partyRelationshipId and changeKind). An HR editor's (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT, PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise); another user's draft, or a change of an employment outside the caller's scope, is missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). None found answers no draft.

parameter.name: draftKind
parameter.description: hire or change

parameter.name: draft
parameter.description: The wizard's values so far (the kind's preview parameters)

parameter.name: operationKey
parameter.description: The key the hire or change is made with

service.description: The caller's unfinished hire or change kept (EmploymentDraft): their own draft of the kind (and, for a change, the employment and kind) changed, else a new one from now with its operation key (made once). Only the kind's preview parameters are kept. Refuses as get#EmploymentDraft, a kind not hire or change (KIND_INVALID), an employer outside the caller's scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).
The caller's own draft discarded, once its hire or change is made or when given up; another user's is left as it is (deleted false). An HR editor's (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise).

The apply_EmploymentDueAssignments job (daily): Employment.emplPositionId holds the seat in effect, so each employment whose primary assignment in effect now names another seat (a change dated later, now come) gets it, each in its own transaction, a failing one logged by its employment and the rest going on. A rerun changes nothing; an employment with no assignment in effect is left as it is. P7 (F134): each employer with a separation, transfer, manager change or reorganization applied for a date now come and not yet routed from it (EmploymentChange reroutedDate) routes its waiting People decisions again, each employer in its own transaction, so a leaver's decisions move on the date.

parameter.name: partyRelationshipIds
parameter.description: Only these employments

parameter.name: rerouted
parameter.description: Employers whose waiting People decisions were routed again

service.description: An applied change of an employment in the caller's scope whose date is still to come (a transfer, a manager change, a leave of absence, a return, a reorganization) withdrawn with a reason (F131): its assignments set for that date never take effect (ended on their own start), the assignment before continues, and the department membership, seat and reporting line it would have moved stay as they were; the change is Withdrawn (when, by whom, why). A leave of absence already begun loses only its return date. The employment's waiting changes are superseded. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), a change outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a hire, a separation or a change not applied (NOT_WITHDRAWABLE), one in effect (CHANGE_IN_EFFECT), one a later change follows (LATER_CHANGE_SCHEDULED), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED) and a seat another holds by then (POSITION_OCCUPIED). A separation dated before scheduled changes withdraws them itself, and a return the leave's scheduled return.

parameter.name: whole
parameter.description: false when only a begun leave's return was withdrawn

service.description: Why an app's provisioning or access end request for an applied hire or separation failed, kept on its change (EmploymentChange accessRequestFailure, with the date) and logged by employment: the hire or change stands, and the request is made again by its key (a success clears it). For the change's requester, an HR editor of its employer or the one whose decision applied it; anyone else, and another change, is refused alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The lifecycle checklist templates of the employers in the caller's scope (organizationPartyId narrows, refused outside the scope, ORGANIZATION_DENIED; lifecycleKindEnumId: onboarding, transfer or offboarding; ended ones with includeEnded): name, employer, kind, dates and state, and their steps (name, required, who does it, due offset, source link, visibility, protected flag, named person; ended steps marked when asked). An HR reader's (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW, PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise); canEdit for an HR editor.

A lifecycle checklist template (design §12 ChecklistTemplates): new (an employer in the caller's scope, its lifecycle kind and name: an isTemplate root WorkEffort with purpose WepPrOrgMgmt, People's process policy, which guards nothing, and its ChecklistTemplate row), changed (name and description, at the revision read when given) or ended (end: from now, never deleted; the checklists it started stay). An HR editor's (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT, PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise); refuses an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a template outside it (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), a kind not onboarding, transfer or offboarding (KIND_INVALID) and a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED).

A step of a checklist template in the caller's scope, over mantle.work.ProcessServices.store#ProcessStep: new (workEffortName) or changed (workEffortId), with who does it (roleTypeId: Employee, Manager, HumanResourcesManager, or any other role for the named person, assigneePartyId, employed by the template's employer now), its due offset in days from the change's date (dueOffsetDays), whether it is required, and People's facts: what it links to (sourceLinkEnumId: IT access, equipment return, exit interview), who sees it (visibilityEnumId) and whether it is protected (isProtected: left out of a phone's Tasks); or ended (end). An HR editor's. Refuses as store#Checklist, a step of another template (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a value not of its list (VALUE_INVALID), a role with no named person (ASSIGNEE_REQUIRED) or one not employed by the employer (ASSIGNEE_OUTSIDE).

The checklists of an applied hire, transfer or separation (employmentChangeId), run by Mantle's tx-commit rules on hire#Employee, apply#, decide# and approve#EmploymentChange (PeopleChecklists.secas.xml): each template of the employer and kind in use now in its own transaction (start#Checklist), and for a separation its equipment return (start#EquipmentReturn); a failure is logged by employment and template, the rest go on and the change stands. The change's own record decides (a manager whose approval applied a transfer starts its checklist); a change not applied starts nothing; a retry answers what was made.

One template's checklist for an applied change (start#Checklists', in its own transaction): the template (of the change's employer and kind) instantiated by instantiate#WorkProcess under the key of the change and template (a retry answers it), its root named for the person, from the change's date (the due offsets), each task assigned by its step's role (the employee, their manager, the HR officer who asked for the change, else the step's named person), People's step facts copied (offboarding tasks protected), the IT access task linked to the change's access request, and the EmploymentChecklist recorded. Refuses a change not applied or a template of another employer (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or kind (KIND_INVALID).

An applied separation's equipment return (start#Checklists', in its own transaction): one task per AssetPartyAssignment the person holds on its date, under a root of People's policy, protected, due on the date and assigned to the HR officer who asked for the separation, each naming its assignment by a WorkEffortAssetAssign of the asset and a WorkEffortParty of the holder in the assignment's role (F60). An assignment with an open return task is left (a retry makes none again).

Mantle's rule on the end of an AssetPartyAssignment (PeopleChecklist.eecas.xml; F45, F52): the open equipment return tasks of the asset, holder and role completed through mantle.work.TaskServices.set#TaskStatus, whoever ends the holding (People's return#Equipment, Warehouse's or Maintenance's custody change). Never refuses: a failure is logged and the custody change stands.

People's context of a checklist or equipment return task (WorkItemDetail's People mount, design §13): for one of its current parties, an HR reader of the employment's employer, or the employee when the step is visible to them, the person, employer, checklist and kind by name, what it links to (the equipment; the Admin outcome of the IT access request, as its state and its steps' states), whether it is protected and the checklist's other tasks; the employee's partyId only for HR. Anyone else, and a task of no checklist, is refused alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Never pay or a case's text.

parameter.name: exitInterview
parameter.description: A step linking an exit interview (impl-people P16 review): the form (the employer's only published exit interview form, or the one answered), whether it was recorded, whether the caller records it (one of the task's people) and the answers for the task's people and HR readers

service.description: The exit interview a checklist step links (ClsExitInterview, impl-people P16 review): one of the task's current people (a protected task: an assignee who is not the leaver) records the leaver's answers once (ALREADY_ANSWERED) on the employer's published form of the exit interview purpose (FORM_REQUIRED for none or several), checked against it (FORM_VALUES_INVALID); kept as a FormInvitation naming the leaver and the task, with no link. Anyone else, and a task of no such step, is refused alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Read back through get#ChecklistTask alone.

Employee360's AssignedEquipment: the equipment a person holds now (current AssetPartyAssignment rows: asset, product, serial, role, from date, the open return task), for the person themselves (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE) or an HR reader of an employer of theirs; refused alike when missing or outside (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). No cost. canReturn for an HR editor. With checkOnly (P23 review), a person the caller may not read answers equipmentList null instead of RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, alike either way.

People's EquipmentDetail (design §13): an asset a person the caller reads as HR holds or held (or the caller themselves): its identity (product, serial, status, location; never cost) and its custody history with each open return task and whether the caller may end a holding (an HR editor of the holder's employer). Refused alike when missing or outside (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A holding ended by the equipment's return (EquipmentDetail's End assignment): the current AssetPartyAssignment of the asset, holder and role replaced by one of the receiving custodian (newPartyId: a person employed now by one of the caller's employers, not the holder) through mantle.product.AssetServices.replace#AssetPartyAssignment, which ends every other holder of the role (F52); Mantle's rule on the end completes the return task. An HR editor of the holder's employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for a holding outside the scope); refuses no or a wrong custodian (CUSTODIAN_INVALID).

parameter.name: completed
parameter.description: No open return task of the holding is left

service.description: Whether a row would hire one employee into the batch's employer (scopeKey) by preview#Hire's own checks, changing nothing: the person (an existing one by partyId, admitted as the hire wizard admits one, or a new one by first and last name and work email, a person matching refused unless the row confirms a new one), the start and optional end, and the first assignment (department, position, manager, work location by id). An HR editor's who also holds PEOPLE_IMPORT; refuses an employer outside the scope. A first salary (salaryAmount, salaryCurrencyUomId, salaryPeriodTypeId, salaryFromDate; the user's call of Nov 12, 2026): for an importer who also holds PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_VIEW its terms are checked as a pay change's, an error of the row; for anyone else its columns alone are refused (a warning, PERMISSION_DENIED), as is a salary the employment has already (PAY_CHANGE_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: salaryReasonCode
parameter.description: Why the row's salary is refused or invalid, else empty

service.description: One hire#Employee for a validated row, with the row's operation key, so a repeat answers the hire it made (resultRef: the employment). No account is requested (provisioning follows a hire only when HR asks for it). An HR editor's who also holds PEOPLE_IMPORT. The row's first salary is written at once for an importer who also holds PAYROLL_EDIT and PAYROLL_VIEW (the import's exception to a first salary's approval: logged, its audit reason "Employee import"); for anyone else, or for an employment with a salary already (PAY_CHANGE_REQUIRED), the hire is made and the salary named as not imported in the result.

parameter.name: salaryReasonCode
parameter.description: Why the row's salary was not written, else empty

service.description: The employers an import of employees may be for and whose imports the caller may read: those in the caller's People scope, for an HR reader (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW). None otherwise.

The caller's own self-service summary (design §3 SelfService MySummary), with PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE: their own party alone (the service takes no party: a supplied one is dropped and changes nothing), their current and coming employments (employer, job title, department, manager, work location, dates and state), their emergency contacts, and how many of their own People requests wait (find#MyRequests) and People tasks are theirs to do (find#DueWork's myTask, a protected task about them left out). Never pay. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE or a party (PERMISSION_DENIED), or with checkOnly answers available false. P10: the caller's own weeks to submit (the missing-week card; mantle.work.TimesheetServices.find#WeeksToSubmit, the rule of Projects' Today). The cards of later phases (balances, the clock, payslips) join here.

The caller's own only: the service takes no user or party. Later phases' requests (leave, expense claims) join with their kinds. Paged. Refuses a call with no user (PERMISSION_DENIED).

service.description: The caller's current reports (design §3 MyTeam Team), with PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW: the people of their live reporting lines, one row per employment at an employer the line is at (never a report's employment at another employer), as the public work identity with the department, work location and whether they work or are on a leave of absence now, and the working schedule they follow now (P9); no employment id, private contact or pay. The caller's own lines only: the service takes no manager or party. Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED). Who is out and missing time join with P12 and P10.

service.description: The due work the caller clears (design §3 Home DueWork, MyTeam Decisions, SelfService), of the kinds asked (every kind they may read when none is): decision, the People decisions waiting on them now (PEOPLE_REQUEST_APPROVE: a request whose step waiting they may decide); noManager, an HR reader's employees with no manager at an employer in scope; checklistTask, the open lifecycle tasks (checklist steps, equipment returns) of those employers, an HR reader's; myTask, the caller's own open People tasks. A protected task about the caller (their own offboarding) is never in it, as HR or as its assignee, unless its step is the employee's to see. Overdue first, then by due date. Paged. Refuses an unknown kind (KIND_INVALID), a caller who may read none of the kinds asked (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

parameter.description: The kinds read

service.description: Add, change or end one of a person's emergency contacts (design §4 PersonalInfo; the user's call on F80): a Person party of its own with its names and phone, linked from the person by a dated PrtEmergencyContact relationship (relationshipName: spouse, parent, ...), held as private contact data (Party.privateOwnerUserId _PEOPLE_PRIVATE_, so no directory, contact book, palette, contact list or search shows it to anyone). The person themselves (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE) or an HR editor (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT) of an employer of theirs, as store#PersonalInfo. Without contactPartyId a contact is added; with it, changed at the revision read, or ended with end (never deleted). Refuses a person outside the scope and a contact not theirs (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a caller who may change nothing of the person (PERMISSION_DENIED), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), no name (NAME_REQUIRED), no phone (PHONE_REQUIRED) and a sixth contact (CONTACT_LIMIT).

parameter.description: The employee

parameter.name: contactPartyId
parameter.description: A current emergency contact of theirs, to change or end

parameter.name: expectedRevision
parameter.description: The contact's revision read (get#Employee360's or get#SelfService's)

service.description: Tells the users of a party newly assigned to a task of People's lifecycle work (a checklist step, an equipment return; mantle.work.TaskServices.notify#TaskAssigned hands such a task here) on the topic PeopleTaskAssigned, whose title names who assigned it and when it is due and nothing of the person or the change: workEffortId, assignedByName, dueDateText, and the task as the record. Not the user who assigned it; to the assignee's users alone (directOnly: a subscription to every message of the topic receives none). A failure is logged, not the assignment's.

The letter of an employment change for an HR reader of its employer (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside, as a missing one; a letter holding pay terms with PAYROLL_VIEW too): once issued the stored letter (letter: its location, file name and type, who issued it and when; never rendered again), before the preview (letterHtml, People's letter template marked as a draft) and whether the caller issues it (canIssue). A change applied and not withdrawn has one when it is a hire, a transfer, a manager change, a leave of absence, a return or a separation (offered, else problem says why).

An HR editor of the employer (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT; PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside) issues the letter of an applied change (CHANGE_NOT_APPLIED for one waiting, refused, superseded or withdrawn; LETTER_NOT_OFFERED for a working schedule or a reorganization): rendered once from People's letter template (the person, the employer, the change's date and terms; never the change's reason) and stored as its PDF, or its html-print page where the server has no PDF engine, with who issued it and when. One letter per change, the change locked: an issue retried answers the first (repeated).

The issued lifecycle letters addressed to the caller (a hire's confirmation, a transfer, a manager change, a leave of absence, a return, a separation), newest first, with PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE (PERMISSION_DENIED): the caller's own party alone (no party is taken). Each its title, employer, issue date and file name.

One of the caller's own issued lifecycle letters as it was stored, whole (pay included: the letter is theirs), with PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE (PERMISSION_DENIED): its location, file name and type. Another person's letter, an offer's or a missing one is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.

The People preferences of the employers of the caller's scope (or the one asked) that they may change: the clocking default (the PartySetting PeopleClocking, Y or N; an employment's own setting comes first, Attendance.js isClockingOn), and, for the People administrator, the confidential case intake handlers (PeopleCaseIntake) with their names and whether each may take a case now (never a case), and with one employer asked the people who could. Each employer with its settings revision. Refuses a caller who is neither the People administrator (PEOPLE_CONFIGURE) nor an HR editor (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT) (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an employer outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

Changes an employer's People preferences, each given one when it changed, audit-logged with the reason as a change of the employer's settings: the clocking default (clocking Y or N; CLOCKING_INVALID otherwise), by the People administrator or an HR editor of the employer; the confidential case intake handlers (intakeHandlerIds, a list or comma separated party ids; empty names nobody, so a filing there is refused NO_CASE_HANDLER), by the People administrator of the employer alone, each one an enabled account holding PEOPLE_CASE_HANDLE working for the employer (HANDLER_NOT_ELIGIBLE). Refuses a caller without the right for a setting given (PERMISSION_DENIED), an employer outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), nothing to change (NOTHING_TO_CHANGE) and a stale expectedRevision (REVISION_STALE: required with the intake handlers, which replace the whole list; checked when given with the clocking default). Answers the employer's settings as get#Settings does and the settings changed.
